$comment: Runtime replays original full-tree closure and exact minimal member selection; both roots remain mandatory custody inputs.

DependencyCandidateReference.description: A lexical candidate, including graph-missed calls; never a complete type/call proof.
DependencyCandidateReference.title: DependencyCandidateReference

DependencyConstructorBinding.description: Nominal constructor source dependencies, not initialization order or deployability.
DependencyConstructorBinding.title: DependencyConstructorBinding

DependencyStaticEdge.description: One exact source-to-source dependency; its referenced declaration is retained too.
DependencyStaticEdge.title: DependencyStaticEdge

DevelopmentCorpusManifest.$comment: Runtime consumers recompute the entire versioned dependency, argument/return and lexical member context from exact retained source bytes. Import or declaration bindings are not complete static call closure, filesystem custody, deployment, compilation or audit completeness. Any tree receipt requires actual root replay. Version1.9 requires a complete tree receipt and source-recomputed graph/syntax/typed-call composition; Version1.10 additionally requires exact disjoint primary/context membership over all retained sources. Version1.11 additionally binds the original complete tree; a derived bundle cannot detach original-root custody. CALL_CLOSED is only the recorded static supplied-tree dependency relation, not audit authority.
DevelopmentCorpusManifest.description: Declared selected files only; a digest does not authenticate provenance or completeness.
DevelopmentCorpusManifest.title: DevelopmentCorpusManifest

DevelopmentCorpusPartitionOrigin.description: A mandatory original-tree binding, not independent provenance or lineage evidence.
DevelopmentCorpusPartitionOrigin.title: DevelopmentCorpusPartitionOrigin

DevelopmentCorpusSourcePartition.$comment: Runtime requires canonical disjoint primary/context roles whose union exactly equals retained sources.
DevelopmentCorpusSourcePartition.description: Every retained source has exactly one role; context is not primary review.
DevelopmentCorpusSourcePartition.title: DevelopmentCorpusSourcePartition

DevelopmentCorpusTreeDirectory.description: Exact child-name/type digest; no non-source file contents are read or retained.
DevelopmentCorpusTreeDirectory.title: DevelopmentCorpusTreeDirectory

DevelopmentCorpusTreeEvidence.description: An enumeration receipt, never proof of the filesystem from a self-hash alone.
DevelopmentCorpusTreeEvidence.title: DevelopmentCorpusTreeEvidence

DevelopmentDependencyClosure.description: Self-hashes bind evidence; the source consumer must additionally recompute it.
DevelopmentDependencyClosure.title: DevelopmentDependencyClosure
